xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Non-Submission of Statutory forms and alleged short payment of duty amounting to MINR 126.73 relating to period 2014-15. The matter is pending before Joint Commissioner, Sales Tax, West Bengal.
There were two cases for FY 2014-15 under CST act and VAT act for amount of MINR 5.77 and MINR 120.96 respectively.
(Disclosure was made in the Annual Report 2022-23)
The case under VAT act pertains to disallowance of Input tax credit along with other miscellaneous issues. This case includes refund of MINR 61.70 and current total assessment of demand is MINR 182.66.
The Company has filed an appeal before Sales Tax Tribunal. The matter is sub-judice.

Input tax claim disallowed, non-submission of declaration forms amounting to MINR 111.01 (including interest & penalties) relating to period 2011-12
(Disclosure was made in the Annual Report 2022-23). The Company has filed an appeal before sales Tax Tribunal. The matter is sub-judice.

Disallowance on account of bad debts written off and various other disallowances amounting to MINR 246.32 for the period 2012-13 & 2013-14.
The Company has filed an appeal before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals). The Tax authorities have adjusted refunds of other years against such demand. The matter is pending for adjudication before CIT(A).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr:
The Company had applied for settlement of ongoing tax appeals filed against assessment order of AY 2012-13 and AY 2013-14 under Direct Tax Vivad se Vishvas Scheme 2024. The tax authorities have accepted Company's application with no pending demand and closed the tax disputes for both the years.
The appeal filed with the CIT(A) against re-assessment order for AY 2012-13 is still pending for adjudication. The estimated demand for this matter is MINR 99.79.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Assessment Order passed under Section 143(3) read with Section 144C(13) and Section 144B of the Income-Tax Act,1961(‘the Act’) for the income tax return filed for the Assessment Year 2021-22 demanding tax amount of INR 21,46,21,719/- after income adjustments (“Assessment Order”). The Assessment Order further mentions about initiation of penalty proceedings separately under Section 270A and Section 271AA of the Act.
The Company has filed appeal with ITAT against final assessment order. The matter is pending for adjudication. Company's rectification application is pending for disposal before the assessing officer

The order passed under Section 147 read with section 144B of the Income tax Act for the Assessment Year 2017-18 demanding tax amount of INR 18,52,64,754/- after income adjustments (“Assessment Order”). The Assessment Order further mentions about initiation of penalty proceedings separately under Section 270A of the Act.
Furthermore, the High Court of Gujarat at Ahmedabad, in its order dated August 30, 2024, has allowed the proceedings to continue. However, it has directed that no final assessment order shall be passed without the court’s permission during the pendency of the petition.
The order came to the knowledge of the Compliance Officer on March 27, 2025, at 4:34 p.m. (IST).
